findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: Line 101 sets totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare: which is Italian, not Lithuanian. The previous Lithuanian value was removed to strip HTML, but the replacement is in the wrong language. Shipping this will show Italian to Lithuanian users. It needs a proper Lithuanian translation without HTML.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: Line 71 sets loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare: which is Italian in a Lithuanian (lt) bundle. Same copy-paste error as the account bundle. Lithuanian users will see Italian. Provide a Lithuanian string without anchor tags.

findings.title: Simplified-Chinese bundle uses Traditional characters
findings.body: Line 112 is totpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一： which uses Traditional forms (手機, 應用程式) in a zh_CN Simplified-Chinese file. Simplified should use 手机/应用. This looks copied from zh_TW. Fix to Simplified characters.

findings.title: Missing English file throws RuntimeException instead of MojoExecutionException
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() loads the English counterpart and on IOException throws new RuntimeException. verify() only converts IOException to MojoExecutionException, so this escapes as an unchecked crash with stack trace instead of a proper plugin error. It also fires when verifying an English file whose derived path is missing or any translation without an _en counterpart. Wrap and throw MojoExecutionException.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message omits key and file
findings.body: When an anchor tag does not match the source, the code adds "Didn't find anchor tag ... in original string" without the bundle key or file path, unlike the Illegal HTML message on line 111 which includes both. A maintainer seeing this failure cannot tell which key or locale failed. Include key and file in the message.

findings.title: Anchor check does not detect dropped anchors and has no passing test
findings.body: santizeAnchors() only iterates over anchors found in the translated value and compares them in order to English anchors. If a translation drops a required ... link entirely the loop never fires and no error is reported. There is also no test asserting that a valid translation produces zero messages, so over- or under-strict behavior is not caught. Add a check for missing expected anchors and positive test cases.
